items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: He didn't play, oh, he didn't play. I don't think he played six or eight months. Then he cut out of me.

ctx.x: That was Chairman's brother. Oh, yeah. He started to play in trombone. But he didn't, he didn't, he didn't stay with us, you know.
Edward, yeah. He didn't play, oh, he didn't play. I don't think he played six or eight months. Then he cut out of me. But he got in bed coming, and he cut out.
